acceptanceCriteria: A failed hook is reported, and the result says the switch still happened.
Rollback restores the previous binary and service state.
Live attempts are adopted or the update waits, per the existing compatibility rules.
The result lists hook outputs and retry counts.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1042 (opened 2026-10-17). Feature request; not yet specified. Problem After the binary changes, host-adapter qualification bound to the exact binary is stale and the running dispatcher still uses the old build. `apply` neither restarts the dispatcher nor triggers requalification. Current workaround A script waits for no live attempts, stops the dispatcher, switches symlinks, re-runs adapter qualification up to three times (flaky under load), and restarts the supervisor. Proposal `apply --restart-service PROGRAM` drains the service, switches and resumes on the new build. `--post-switch CMD` hooks run with bounded timeouts and retries, recorded in the update result. Roll back automatically if the service does not start. See beamfall/corvint#1042 for the full text.
title: update apply: restart the service and run post-switch hooks (issue #1042)
